# Test fixture data

lagsugi makes the project-authored data in `policy/` and `parity/` available under [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) to the extent of the rights held by lagsugi. This covers the generated policy observations and outputs, authored test inputs, and project-recorded measurements and metadata for the isolated parity trials. CC0 permits commercial reuse.

The policy fixtures contain Rust inference inputs and outputs. The parity fixtures contain test scenarios, numeric observations from isolated test sessions, and replay and comparison data. The [parity guide](../../tools/parity/README.md) describes the loopback test setup and synthetic player identities. The fixture provenance and origin files identify the recording scopes and upstream versions where available. Names and checksums of upstream software identify the systems under test and remain subject to any applicable third-party rights.
